rule: Paperclip-native JSONL is the only authorized authority baseline until Governance approves an alternative.
allowed_effect: Use native ledgers as the baseline for current-truth and authority reconstruction.
forbidden_effect: Do not treat an external provider result as AuthorityLedger state.

rule: No provider may write to AuthorityLedger without Governance approval.
allowed_effect: Evaluate providers only as no-write, read-only, sandbox or challenger evidence when explicitly scoped.
forbidden_effect: No durable authority write by Graphiti, MemPalace, Supermemory, GBrain or any other provider.

rule: Provider promotion requires clean-room projection, no-write proof, privacy/export/provenance gate, baseline comparison, blind fresh-agent recovery, quarantine/rollback proof and Governance sign-off.
allowed_effect: Open a Governance issue with evidence paths when promotion is proposed.
forbidden_effect: Do not skip gates because a synthetic or local smoke passed.

rule: Candidate, sandbox and challenger material can be evidence only; it must not write to canonical AuthorityLedger or EvidenceLog.
allowed_effect: Store such material in review queues or projection surfaces with rollback/quarantine notes.
forbidden_effect: No unilateral promotion by any company, agent or controller.

rule: MiniMax, DeepSeek, Tavily and Brave are quarantined/no-production-use for this Real OS acceptance run.
allowed_effect: Record them as provider quarantine constraints only.
forbidden_effect: No production routing, source expansion or memory promotion through these providers in Task 6.

rule: Finbot and local LLM lanes remain research-only during this acceptance plan.
allowed_effect: Use them only for supervised research evidence or benchmark comparison under their validators.
forbidden_effect: No investment advice, production watchlist, trade signal, broker action or local-model production routing.
